project.title: MasteryLoop (mastree)
project.short_description: Open-source adaptive learning engine implementing Bloom's mastery learning with IBM Db2 LUW recursive graph analytics, multi-mode ingestion (Wikipedia/PDF/Notes), FastAPI backend, static vanilla frontend, and dual teaching formats (Board & in-browser Video Lecture).
project.category: AI / Education / Data Engineering / Adaptive Learning

members.name: Suryakanth
members.role: Solo Participant — Full-Stack Architecture, Db2 LUW Analytics & AI Engine

ibm_db2.edition: IBM Db2 LUW (Community Edition / Enterprise Server 12.01.0500)
features_used: Recursive CTE (Ancestor Prerequisite Root Cause Analysis without RECURSIVE keyword)
Analytical View (v_student_progress cross-joining students and curriculum matrix)
Atomic ACID Transactions with Autocommit Off and Rollback
Foreign Key and Composite Performance Indexes (student_id, concept_id)
Persistent Vector & LLM Response Cache Table (llm_cache with SHA-256 keys)
BLOB Image Table for Optional Lesson Illustrations (lesson_images)
